prompt_cases.title: Company holiday party with AI-authored dialogue

params.prompt: Jerry Seinfeld, Michael Scott from The Office, and Ron Swanson from Parks and Rec are all standing and talking to each other at company holiday party.

review: Keep Jerry, Michael, and Ron distinct and present in the holiday-party conversation.
The generated dialogue should contain 22–30 words and remain attributable to the characters.
Inspect any native fallback or planning warning; a completed response alone is not warning-free evidence.

prompt_cases.title: Silent red kite

params.prompt: A cinematic continuous shot of a red kite flying above a grassy field in a gentle breeze, with soft wind and distant birds. No speech or music.

review: Keep the kite and its flight readable in the field.
No spoken words or music should be added.
